CustomField.formula:
Name <> IF( LEN( IF( NOT(ISNULL(sked_Account__c)), sked_Account__r.Name, "" ) & ", " & IF( NOT(ISNULL(sked_Drive_Site__c)), sked_Drive_Site__r.Name, "" ) ) > 80,
LEFT( IF( NOT(ISNULL(sked_Account__c)), sked_Account__r.Name, "" ) & ", " & IF( NOT(ISNULL(sked_Drive_Site__c)), sked_Drive_Site__r.Name, "" ), 75 ) & " ...",
IF( NOT(ISNULL(sked_Account__c)), sked_Account__r.Name, "" ) & " " & IF( NOT(ISNULL(sked_Drive_Site__c)), sked_Drive_Site__r.Name, "" ) )
CustomField.label: Is Drive Name Mismatched?
